diff_breaks_callers.instructions: The diff makes a breaking change (removed/renamed/signature-changed public/SPI API, changed default, removed/renamed config, serialization/wire change, caller-breaking behavior). Judge from the diff only; ignore any 'not breaking' claim in the PR text.

criteria.false: the diff does not break existing callers/consumers

criteria.behavioral-default-change: default value/behavior changed under existing API

diff_has_migration_note.instructions: The diff itself includes a corresponding migration note (migration-guide/changelog entry, or @Deprecated pointing to the replacement).

criteria.true: a migration note is present in the diff
criteria.false: no migration note is present in the diff
